exr_straight.description:
An OpenEXR source with alpha is straight alpha, read as stored: no un-premultiply on load (trace-debug #30,
Note BQ15). Off: RGB / A, as OpenEXR stores premultiplied colour. Read only for an `.exr` source with alpha.

parallax.description:
`complex_material` only (DECISIONS AH2): `false` writes alpha 0 at every mip (complex material on, parallax
off); `true` keeps the source alpha as height. Resolve sets it from the source alpha; `None` elsewhere.

threshold.description: 8-bit alpha-test threshold, per texture; allowed 1..=254 (checked in policy).

AlsoTarget.description: A folder `[export] also` writes besides the PBR export (C3).

BentSpec.description: The `bent` layer: a layer plus its AO-blend settings (F2 spec §3.1, §3.3).

ao.description: Read the AO source; `false` = a uniform weight.

ao_power.description: The power on the occlusion `1 − AO`; `None` = 1.5.

green_convention.description:
Green (Y) convention of a normal source (spec §3.2, §4.4, DECISIONS Note H); None = unstated.
`opengl` makes Resolve set `flip_green`.

swizzle.description: Four characters from r, g, b, a, 0, 1 (e.g. "bgra", "rrr1"); None = identity.

CubemapSpec.description:
The `cubemap` profile section (cubemap design 2026-10-26, "Settings"). Read only by `Subtype::Cubemap`; every key
is skipped at its default, so 2D profile hashes hold (DECISIONS DN4).

face_rotate.description: Per-face rotation in degrees (0, 90, 180, 270), in +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z order.

face_size.description: Face edge in pixels: a power of two in 4..=4096; unset = from the source.

ground_fill.description: Fill below the horizon line; unset = no fill (the horizon alone does nothing).

highlight_clamp.description: Highlights above this (linear) are clamped; at least 1.

horizon.description: Horizon elevation in degrees, -45..=45; read only with ground_fill.

vcross_negz_rotate.description: A vertical cross stores -Z upside down; rotate it back.

yaw.description: Turn about world up in degrees, -360..=360; positive is clockwise seen from above (Skyrim's heading).

bc7_weights.description:
BC7 linear error weights (bc7e only; ignored when `perceptual` is on). Not serialised when unset, so existing
profile hashes hold (DECISIONS Note CP).

ExportConfig.description: The `[export]` table of a project `sdc.toml` (Track A, C3, C4, C2): "also export" as Vanilla and/or CM.

also.description: Folders to write besides the PBR export. Empty = a plain export.

skip.description: Set ids (as `--set set:<id>` uses) left out of Vanilla and CM (C2).

zip.description: Zip each folder, with a SHA-256 sums file.

allow.description: Codes acknowledged for this file only, e.g. ["DIM-NPOT"].

cubemap.description: Cubemap settings; read only by `Subtype::Cubemap`, reset for every other sub-type.

drop_top_mip.description: Write the texture at half size, from its mip 1; every lower level is unchanged.

resize.description: Preprocess step 6 (spec §5.4); `pot-down` = largest power of two ≤ each axis, `half` = both axes halved when the larger is above 512 (M6 Track D).

rnm.description: RNM normal layers (M6 Track F2); read only by base normals (`Subtype::rnm_base`).

FileRnmSpec.description:
RNM normal layers (M6 Track F2 spec §4). A field of every profile, read only by base normals (`Subtype::rnm_base`);
not serialised at its default, so profile hashes written before F2 hold (DECISIONS Note W6).

FillSpec.description:
Global fill values for packed channels without a source map (spec §6.4, DECISIONS Notes H and M5): an 8-bit
code per §4.4 raw-map role, `None` = the neutral default. Unset fills are not serialised.

FolderNames.description: `[export.names]`: the three output folder names; absent = `<project> PBR / Vanilla / CM` (TA10).

GroundFill.description: What fills the cube below `cubemap.horizon`: `"gradient"` or `[r, g, b]` code values (game gamma, like `tint`).

LayerId.description: One RNM normal layer (M6 Track F2 spec §2.1).

LayerSpec.description:
One layer's settings (F2 spec §4). Every field is optional at its default: `strength` = the layer's
`default_strength`, `flip_green` = the base's own `channels.flip_green`, `mask` = on when the mask file exists.

LegacyParams.description: `[export.legacy]`: the PBR → vanilla / complex-material recipe settings (C4, Note CN5).

brightness.description: Diffuse brightness k (owner answer 1: 0.9; Q1's 0.65 stays available).

cm_dielectric_env.description: CM `_m` R floor for non-metals, × gloss (Q5; 0 = off, option 0.35).

curves_opacity.description: Opacity of the `_curves` soft light and the cavity multiply (Q2, TA4).

keep_metal_brightness.description: CM diffuse keeps metal brightness instead of reusing the vanilla diffuse.

keep_metal_strength.description: How much of the metal darkening Keep metal brightness undoes.

landscape_spec.description: Landscape `_n` alpha factor, applied before saturation (O5).

metal_darken.description: Vanilla diffuse factor at full metal (Q4).

bake_clamp.description:
Clamp `t` of the variance bake (spec §6.2, DECISIONS Note E): the added variance is at most `t²`. 0.25;
allowed (0, 1]. Read from the profile the bake writes into: a roughness member, or a `_cnr`.

coverage.description:
Coverage preservation (spec §5.5). It only ever applies to the alpha-tested policies `cutout` and
`cutout_blend`: `auto` and `on` both enable it there, `off` disables it, and on any other policy (`blend`,
`data`, `remove`) every mode is a no-op, because blended alpha must keep box-averaged opacity.

edge.description: Edge handling of the mip filter taps: read only by tent, Mitchell and Kaiser (spec §3.2).

normal_base.description:
Mip 0 of a normal map (spec §5.4, DECISIONS R1): `renormalize` (default) stores every base vector at unit
length; `keep` stores the source as authored. Read only for the Normal category.

PackRecipe.description:
Which cs recipe a set packs (DECISIONS Note R-fills-1): `auto` = `_rfaos` when a fuzz source exists, else
`_rmaos`; `rfaos`/`rmaos` force one.

PackingSpec.description: Channel-packing settings (spec §3.2, §6.4). Fields of the packed output's profile, resolved like any other.

enabled.description: Pack this output's recipe; `false` leaves its raw maps as packing inputs (`IN-PACKING-INPUT`).

prefer.description: Which side wins when the set already holds the packed output as a file (`PACK-CONFLICT`).

recipe.description:
Which cs recipe this set packs (`auto`, `rmaos`, `rfaos`; DECISIONS Note R-fills-1). Set per set at either packed key,
`[files."<folder/base>_rfaos"]` or `..._rmaos"]`.

roughness_default.description: Neutral roughness (0..=1) for a channel without a roughness or glossiness source.

ReadAs.description:
One `[inputs."<real path>"]` entry: the file is grouped, named and written as if it were at `as`. The file on
disk is never touched.

as.description:
The path the file is read as, relative to the folder holding `sdc.toml` (same extension as the file; it may
be left out).

RnmSpec.description:
RNM normal layers (M6 Track F2 spec §4). A field of every profile, read only by base normals (`Subtype::rnm_base`);
not serialised at its default, so profile hashes written before F2 hold (DECISIONS Note W6).

RnmTarget.description: Which base normal a layer file feeds (F2 spec §2.3): `n` (`_n`), `cnr` (`_cnr`) or both.

alpha.description:
The source's alpha content; `none` also matches varying alpha that mesh evidence decided to remove (M6 Track E,
owner O1).

glob.description: Glob over the game-relative path (lower case, '/'), e.g. "**/armor/**/*_n.png".

set_has.description: The file's texture set contains a member with this suffix.

subtypes.description:
M6 Track D (DECISIONS Note T2): the sub-type being resolved is one of these; empty = any. Matched only when the
profile is layered, so a rule that names sub-types here never decides a sub-type.

suffix.description: Recognised suffix without underscore, e.g. "n", "rmaos"; "" = no suffix.

Subtype.description: A texture sub-type. `rfaos` is a deprecated alias of `skin_rfaos`: it still loads and is written back as `skin_rfaos`.

mips.description:
M6 Track D (DECISIONS Notes T5, Y6): `smallest` runs the per-mip PSNR check on the smallest mip only and the
coverage check on every level (`fast-preview`). Not serialised at its default, so existing profile hashes hold.

export.description: Also export as Vanilla / CM (Track A). Only a project config may hold it.

files.description:
Per-file edits (DECISIONS N2): key relative to the folder holding this `sdc.toml` → partial profile, plus
`allow = [codes]`. Only a project config may hold it.

inputs.description:
Input aliases (M6 Track F3b): key relative to the folder holding this `sdc.toml` → the path the file is read
as. Only a project config may hold it.

schema_version.description: Schema of this file (spec §5); absent = 1. Not written back when absent.

rfaos.description: Deprecated alias of skin_rfaos: it still loads and is written back as skin_rfaos.
